desc:
👋 Welcome to Paint To Hide! 🎨
🖌️ Paint yourself into the map and disappear. Can you hide in plain sight?

🫣 As Hider: Paint yourself to blend into the map. DON'T GET CAUGHT!
👀 As Seeker: Hunt down the hiders. Catch them and they join your team. FIND THEM ALL!

✨ Features:
🎨 Unique paint-to-camouflage mechanic
🗺️ Multiple maps to hide and seek across
🔄 Fast, replayable rounds
🎥 Free cam for hiders (Shift + P)
🔐 Private servers come with FREE admin panels!

⚠️ Do NOT abuse the paint system. Abusers will be banned. Report abusers to Roblox ⚠️

👍 Like ⭐ Favorite 🔔 Follow for more updates and new maps!

💬 Join our community 🌎
👉 https://www.roblox.com/communities/778544062 👈
